truth_boundary: This Procedural family compresses only the repeated front/rear header emission pattern already source-owned by Building Hard Surface. It now binds explicitly to the Hard-Surface emission-variant contract: the 19-box representation remains the unchanged default and the 23-box segmented representation remains opt-in only. Procedural may reproduce the two header representations exactly for evidence, but it does not choose downstream adoption, invent segmentation semantics, alter occupied union, generalize to arbitrary members, replace Hard-Surface ownership, or establish architecture, manufacturing, runtime, gameplay, visual acceptance, CANON or production readiness.
